content:
基础设定：基于这张分镜故事板的信息，生成一段充满日式电影美学与叙事感的 粉色罐装气泡水专业商业广告。仅生成0-30秒的画面内容

风格设定：
视觉基调： 现代日式青春电影美学，模拟 120 中画幅胶片（Medium Format Film） 的通透空气感，或数字电影机加装 柔光滤镜（Black Pro-Mist） 的纯净质感。画面干净，颗粒感极弱。
光影色调：高调逆光（High-key Backlight） 与漫反射环境光。高光轻微溢出（Bloom/Halation），呈现柔和的樱花粉与阳光白；暗部保留通透的冷青色（Cyan-blue）。整体呈现低对比度、低饱和度的日系治愈调色。
不要生成背景音乐，仅生成音效。

画面内容：生成一段 30 秒、16:9 竖屏、真实朋友手持拍摄的云南旅行 Vlog。

以参考图中的女性为主角，在整个视频中保持她的面部特征、发型、五官、肤色、身材比例和自然表情一致。不要改变身份，不要换脸，不要变成其他人。主角穿着适合云南旅行的清爽日常穿搭，可以是浅色短袖或薄衬衫、休闲长裙或牛仔短裤、舒适运动鞋，背一个小背包。整体气质自然放松，像真实游客，不是模特摆拍。

视频质感是朋友拿手机全天跟拍的真实旅行 Vlog。画面有自然手持运镜、随意构图、轻微晃动、偶尔对焦不完美、真实抓拍感。不要商业广告质感，不要电影大片感，不要夸张转场，不要人工特效。主角举止自然，像真实旅行中和朋友互动，偶尔看镜头、笑、整理头发、拿手机拍照、走路、停下来观察风景。

0–5 秒：清晨从云南大理的民宿出发。主角背着小背包，从带木门、白墙、绿植和院落感的温馨民宿走出来。她低头查看手机路线，然后抬头对着朋友的镜头自然微笑，随手整理头发，向巷子外走去。镜头从后方和侧后方跟拍，有朋友手持拍摄的轻微晃动。画面里有清晨柔和阳光、安静石板路、白族风格建筑、街边绿植和刚开门的小店。环境声包括鸟叫、远处人声、脚步声和清晨街道声音。

5–11 秒：大理古城街道探索。镜头跟随她在古城街道慢慢走。两侧有白墙灰瓦、木质招牌、鲜花、小咖啡馆、云南小吃店和游客。她走进一家小咖啡馆或街边饮品店，买一杯饮料，接过饮料时自然地笑。她对着镜头简单说一句中文：“今天先去洱海。”然后继续走过街头小店，停下来拍一张照片，低头看相机预览，又忍不住笑。镜头保持近距离，捕捉不经意的真实瞬间，不要摆拍。

11–18 秒：前往洱海。环境从古城街道自然过渡到洱海边的公路和开阔湖景。主角坐在电动车后座或步行来到洱海边，海风吹动她的头发。她第一次看到洱海时明显变得兴奋，回头看向镜头笑，然后快步走向湖边。镜头跟随她走在洱海生态廊道上，旁边有蓝色湖面、远处苍山、白色栏杆、树影和骑行的人。她停下来望向湖面，拿手机拍照，手扶栏杆，表情自然放松。环境声有风声、湖水声、自行车经过声和远处游客说话声。

18–24 秒：喜洲稻田和白族村落午后。镜头切到阳光下的稻田小路，主角和朋友一起走在田边。背景有绿色稻田、白族民居、远山、蓝天和慢慢移动的云。她蹲下看路边小花，起身时回头对镜头笑。她和朋友在村口小摊买当地小吃，边走边吃，表情真实轻松。镜头在人群和小巷之间自然移动，偶尔轻微晃动，像朋友随手记录旅行片段。不要刻意设计动作，不要夸张表演。

24–30 秒：洱海日落结束时刻。金色傍晚，主角坐在洱海边或湖边长椅上，手里拿着饮料，安静看日落。湖面有细碎波光，远处是苍山轮廓和晚霞。朋友的镜头从她侧后方慢慢后退，先拍到她的侧脸和被风吹动的头发，再带出洱海、天空和宁静傍晚景色。最后她回头看向镜头，轻轻笑一下，说一句中文：“云南真的好舒服。”画面停留在真实旅行回忆感上，温暖、松弛、自然。

视觉风格：真实个人旅行 Vlog 素材，像智能手机或小型无反相机拍摄。自然日光，真实曝光，轻微手持晃动，随意构图，真实真人反应，纪录片式写实风格。不要电影商业质感，不要精致广告大片感，不要刻意摆拍姿势，不要人工转场特效，不要文字叠加，不要 Logo，不要水印。

全程保持参考图女性的面部身份、发型、五官、肤色、身材比例和自然表情一致。不要换脸，不要变成其他女性，不要过度美颜，不要二次元，不要网红滤镜感。全程无字幕、无背景音乐，仅保留真实环境声、脚步声、风声、人声、市集声、湖水声、鸟叫声和朋友拍摄时的自然声音。

Basic setup: Based on the information in this storyboard, generate a professional commercial for pink canned sparkling water filled with Japanese cinematic aesthetics and narrative feel. Generate only the visual content from 0–30 seconds.

Style settings:
Visual tone: Modern Japanese youth film aesthetics, simulating the airy clarity of 120 medium format film, or the clean texture of a digital cinema camera with a Black Pro-Mist soft filter attached. The image should be clean, with extremely subtle grain.
Lighting and color tone: High-key backlight and diffuse ambient light. Highlights should bloom slightly (Bloom/Halation), presenting soft cherry blossom pink and sunlight white; shadows should retain a transparent cyan-blue. Overall, use a low-contrast, low-saturation Japanese healing color grade.
Do not generate background music, only sound effects.

Visual content: Generate a 30-second, 16:9 vertical-screen Yunnan travel vlog shot by a real friend holding the camera.

Use the woman in the reference image as the main character, and keep her facial features, hairstyle, facial structure, skin tone, body proportions, and natural expressions consistent throughout the video. Do not change her identity, do not swap faces, do not turn her into someone else. The main character should wear fresh, casual clothing suitable for traveling in Yunnan, such as a light short-sleeve shirt or thin blouse, a casual long dress or denim shorts, comfortable sneakers, and a small backpack. Her overall vibe should be natural and relaxed, like a real tourist, not a posed model.

The video should feel like a real travel vlog filmed by a friend with a phone throughout the day. It should feature natural handheld camera movement, casual framing, slight shaking, occasional imperfect focus, and a genuine candid feel. Do not use commercial-ad style visuals, do not make it feel like a cinematic blockbuster, do not use exaggerated transitions, and do not add artificial effects. The main character should behave naturally, interacting with friends during the trip, occasionally looking at the camera, smiling, fixing her hair, taking photos with her phone, walking, and stopping to look at the scenery.

0–5 seconds: Departing from a homestay in Dali, Yunnan in the morning. The main character, carrying a small backpack, walks out of a cozy homestay with a wooden door, white walls, greenery, and a courtyard feel. She looks down to check the route on her phone, then looks up and naturally smiles at her friend’s camera, casually fixes her hair, and walks out toward the alley. The camera follows from behind and slightly behind the side, with the subtle shake of a handheld shot by a friend. The scene includes soft morning sunlight, quiet stone-paved streets, Bai-style architecture, roadside greenery, and small shops just opening. Ambient sound includes birdsong, distant voices, footsteps, and morning street sounds.

5–11 seconds: Exploring the streets of Dali Ancient Town. The camera follows her as she slowly walks through the ancient town streets. On both sides are white walls with gray tiles, wooden signs, flowers, small cafes, Yunnan snack shops, and tourists. She walks into a small cafe or street drink shop, buys a drink, and naturally smiles when receiving it. She casually says one line in Chinese to the camera: “Today we’re going to Erhai first.” Then she continues walking past small street shops, stops to take a photo, looks down at the camera preview, and can’t help smiling again. The camera stays close, capturing unplanned real moments, with no posed shots.

11–18 seconds: Heading to Erhai. The environment naturally transitions from the ancient town streets to a road by Erhai and an open lake view. The main character either rides on the back of an electric scooter or walks to the lakeside. The lake breeze blows her hair. When she sees Erhai for the first time, she becomes visibly excited, turns back to look at the camera and smile, then quickly walks toward the lake. The camera follows her along the Erhai Ecological Corridor, with the blue lake surface beside her, Cangshan in the distance, white railings, tree shadows, and cyclists passing by. She stops to look at the lake, takes photos with her phone, rests a hand on the railing, and keeps a naturally relaxed expression. Ambient sound includes wind, lake water, bicycles passing, and distant tourists talking.

18–24 seconds: Afternoon in Xizhou rice fields and Bai village. The camera cuts to a sunlit path beside rice fields, where the main character walks along the field edge with her friend. In the background are green rice paddies, Bai-style houses, distant mountains, blue sky, and slowly moving clouds. She crouches to look at small flowers by the roadside, then stands up and turns back to smile at the camera. She and her friend buy local snacks from a small stall at the village entrance and eat while walking, with a real, relaxed expression. The camera moves naturally between the crowd and narrow alleys, with occasional slight shake, like a friend casually recording travel moments. Do not deliberately choreograph actions, and do not overact.

24–30 seconds: Sunset at Erhai, ending moment. In the golden evening, the main character sits by Erhai or on a bench by the lake, holding a drink and quietly watching the sunset. The lake surface has tiny shimmering reflections, with the silhouette of Cangshan and evening clouds in the distance. The friend’s camera slowly pulls back from behind her side, first capturing her profile and hair moving in the wind, then revealing Erhai, the sky, and the calm evening scenery. Finally, she turns back to look at the camera, gives a soft smile, and says in Chinese: “Yunnan is really so comfortable.” The image lingers on the feeling of a real travel memory—warm, relaxed, and natural.

Visual style: Real personal travel vlog footage, as if shot on a smartphone or a small mirrorless camera. Natural daylight, true exposure, slight handheld shake, casual framing, real human reactions, documentary-style realism. Do not use cinematic commercial visuals, do not use polished ad-blockbuster aesthetics, do not use deliberately posed stances, do not add artificial transition effects, do not overlay text, do not include logos, and do not include watermarks.

Throughout, keep the reference woman’s facial identity, hairstyle, facial features, skin tone, body proportions, and natural expressions consistent. Do not swap faces, do not turn her into another woman, do not over-beautify, do not make it anime-like, and do not give it an influencer-filter look. No subtitles and no background music throughout; only preserve real ambient sound, footsteps, wind, human voices, market sounds, lake water sounds, birdsong, and the natural sounds made while her friend is filming.

La protagoniste agit naturellement, comme en voyage réel avec des amis : elle regarde parfois la caméra, sourit, remet ses cheveux en place, prend des photos avec son téléphone, marche, s’arrête pour observer le paysage.

Elle et son amie achètent des spécialités locales à un petit stand à l’entrée du village, mangent en marchant, avec une expression vraie et détendue. La caméra se déplace naturellement entre la foule et les ruelles, avec parfois une légère instabilité, comme si un ami enregistrait des fragments de voyage au hasard. Ne pas chorégraphier les gestes, ne pas exagérer le jeu.

24–30 secondes : moment de fin au coucher du soleil sur Erhai. En fin d’après-midi doré, la protagoniste est assise au bord d’Erhai ou sur un banc près du lac, tenant une boisson, regardant silencieusement le coucher du soleil. La surface du lac scintille de petites lueurs, avec au loin la silhouette des montagnes Cangshan et les nuages du soir. La caméra de son ami recule lentement depuis l’arrière-côté : elle capture d’abord son profil et ses cheveux agités par le vent, puis révèle Erhai, le ciel et la tranquillité du soir. Enfin, elle se retourne vers la caméra, sourit doucement et dit en chinois : « 云南真的好舒服。 » L’image reste sur une sensation de souvenir de voyage authentique, chaleureuse, détendue et naturelle.

映像内容：30秒、16:9、縦画面、友人が手持ちで撮影したリアルな雲南旅行Vlogを生成する。

0〜5秒：雲南・大理の民宿から朝出発。主役は小さなリュックを背負い、木の扉、白い壁、緑の植栽、中庭のある温かみのある民宿から出てくる。スマホでルートを確認し、顔を上げて友人のカメラに自然に微笑み、さりげなく髪を整えながら路地の外へ歩いていく。カメラは後方と斜め後方から追いかけ、友人の手持ち撮影らしい軽い揺れがある。画面には朝のやわらかな日差し、静かな石畳の道、白族風の建築、道端の緑、開店したばかりの小さな店が映る。環境音には鳥のさえずり、遠くの人の声、足音、朝の街の音を含める。

0–5 segundos: saída pela manhã de uma hospedagem em Dali, Yunnan. A protagonista, com uma mochilinha, sai de uma hospedagem acolhedora com porta de madeira, paredes brancas, plantas verdes e clima de pátio. Ela olha para o celular para conferir a rota, depois levanta a cabeça e sorri naturalmente para a câmera do amigo, arruma o cabelo de forma casual e segue pela viela. A câmera acompanha de trás e pela lateral traseira, com leve tremor de câmera na mão. A cena mostra a luz suave da manhã, uma rua de pedra silenciosa, arquitetura no estilo Bai, plantas na rua e pequenas lojas acabando de abrir. 5–11 segundos: exploração das ruas da Cidade Antiga de Dali. A câmera acompanha enquanto ela caminha devagar pelas ruas da cidade antiga. Dos dois lados há paredes brancas com telhados cinza, placas de madeira, flores, pequenos cafés, lojas de comida típica de Yunnan e turistas. Ela entra em um café pequeno ou loja de bebidas na rua, compra uma bebida e sorri naturalmente ao recebê-la. Ela diz uma frase curta em chinês para a câmera: “今天先去洱海。” (“Hoje primeiro vamos para o Lago Erhai.”) Depois continua passando pelas lojinhas, para para tirar uma foto, olha a prévia na câmera e não consegue evitar sorrir. A câmera permanece próxima, capturando momentos reais e espontâneos, sem pose.

11–18 segundos: caminho para o Lago Erhai. O ambiente faz uma transição natural das ruas da cidade antiga para a estrada à beira do Erhai e a paisagem aberta do lago. A protagonista está na garupa de uma scooter elétrica ou chega a pé à margem do Erhai, com o vento do lago mexendo seu cabelo. Ao ver o Erhai pela primeira vez, ela fica visivelmente animada, olha para trás para a câmera e sorri, depois caminha rapidamente em direção à beira do lago. A câmera a acompanha enquanto ela anda pela passarela ecológica do Erhai, com a superfície azul do lago ao lado, as montanhas Cangshan ao fundo, grades brancas, sombras de árvores e pessoas pedalando. Ela para para olhar o lago, tira fotos com o celular, apoia a mão na grade e mantém uma expressão naturalmente relaxada. O som ambiente inclui vento, água do lago, bicicletas passando e vozes de turistas ao longe.

18–24 segundos: tarde em Xizhou, entre arrozais e vilarejos Bai. A câmera corta para uma trilha de arrozal sob a luz do sol, com a protagonista caminhando junto com uma amiga ao lado do campo. Ao fundo há arrozais verdes, casas tradicionais Bai, montanhas distantes, céu azul e nuvens se movendo lentamente. Ela se agacha para olhar pequenas flores à beira do caminho e, ao se levantar, olha para trás e sorri para a câmera. Ela e a amiga compram um lanche local em uma barraca na entrada da vila e comem enquanto caminham, com expressões reais e descontraídas. A câmera se move naturalmente entre a multidão e os becos, com leves tremores ocasionais, como se um amigo estivesse registrando casualmente os momentos da viagem. Não crie ações forçadas, nem atuação exagerada.

24–30 segundos: momento final do pôr do sol no Erhai. No fim da tarde dourada, a protagonista está sentada à beira do Erhai ou em um banco perto do lago, segurando uma bebida e observando o pôr do sol em silêncio. A superfície do lago tem pequenos brilhos, e ao fundo aparecem o contorno das montanhas Cangshan e o céu do entardecer. A câmera do amigo recua lentamente por trás e pela lateral, primeiro captando o perfil dela e o cabelo movido pelo vento, depois revelando o Erhai, o céu e a paisagem tranquila da noite. Por fim, ela olha para a câmera, sorri de leve e diz em chinês: “云南真的好舒服。” (“Yunnan é realmente tão confortável.”) A imagem permanece com a sensação de uma lembrança real de viagem, quente, leve e natural.
